_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution: a mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so `s.stdio.semio.audio`'s oracle registration and catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `s.stdio.semio.audio` is a semio-NATIVE format, so its reference is a second IMPLEMENTATION written in another language from the committed grammars rather than a third-party package.

oracles.rationale:
No third-party library in any ecosystem reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio` envelope, so the second producer THE STANDARD requires is a second IMPLEMENTATION in another language. `../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-semio-audio/🐍️component.py` is that implementation: the `semio <envelope-id>.dsl v1` preamble, the whole `document = artifact-mark schema-line sample-rate-line format-line channels-line tags-line` grammar in both directions, and all ten verbs of this subset's vocabulary together with their inverses — written in Python from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/📝️text/📖️.grammar.semio`, `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️.grammar.semio` and the envelope section of `🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🧬️semio/🦀️.rs`, importing nothing from and transliterating nothing of the Rust it judges. Two leaves the grammar states by reference were settled from the committed artifact and are pinned by byte-exact re-emission: `hex` is the framework macro, so scalars are the lowercase hex of their UTF-8 bytes (`7469746c65` is `title`), and a sample is eight hex digits of IEEE-754 binary32 bits most-significant byte first (`3f000000` is `0.5`, `bf800000` is `-1.0`). `package` is deliberately the empty string: the implementation needs no distribution, so it contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json` and nothing to the import-purity probe. The WAV route was surveyed again and still rejected on the merits rather than for absence — `hound`, `soundfile` and `node-wav` model no `LIST INFO` chunk, so `insert-tag`, `remove-tag` and `set-tag-value` would have had nothing to compare against, and `SemioAudioFormat` records the ORIGINAL encoding the always-`f32` samples were decoded FROM, which a WAV writer cannot represent independently of its own storage. A from-specification second implementation covers all ten kinds instead of four.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `semio-v1-audio-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 10-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.

[2026-09-02, D1 — SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION] Promoted from cross-semio-implementation to verified-native-second-implementation: this artifact is semio-native (isSemioNativeArtifact), this reference's own third-party survey above (kept verbatim) already names what was checked and declined, its python implementation differs from the Rust subject, and it covers 100% of this manifest's 1 capability/capabilities with 1 committed fixture vector(s). See .🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️09/☀️02/SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION/📓️d1-native-oracle-discharge.md.
